Decision: Immutable raw + validated + contextualized + feature/evidence zones
Digital thread is a foundational service, not an analytics add-on
Use graph capability for relationship-heavy lineage/investigation
Hybrid statistical/ML/physics methods selected by evidence
Plant control isolated through read-oriented segmented architecture
Version code/data/features/models/config and support deterministic rollback
Defer provider-specific service mapping until sizing and requirement gates complete
